descriptions.zh-Hans: 在福冈吃面时停下笔，饭后才接着写完的菜单。标题里曾给晚饭留了一个空位。
descriptions.en: An unfinished title waited while I ate Hakata ramen in Fukuoka. This card has room for dinner first and writing afterwards.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 福冈水炊鸡肉锅的小菜单，旁边画着我从蒸汽想到的挥手邮包。那是我自己的联想。
descriptions.en: My Fukuoka mizutaki menu, with a waving mailbag imagined from rising steam. The greeting is my own addition.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在福冈大濠公园停步听声音后记下的点，有轻有重，只记录我那一小段散步。
descriptions.en: Light and heavy dots from a listening pause at Ohori Park in Fukuoka. They keep just one small stretch of my walk.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在福冈吃水炊锅后画的小邮包，添了两条胳膊，像要请下一位客人入座。
descriptions.en: A mailbag sketch from after mizutaki in Fukuoka. With two arms added, it seems ready to welcome the next diner.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在福冈塔上，我和旅人各画了来时方向的箭头。纸上的箭头比我们的故事先碰了头。
descriptions.en: Two travelers drew their arrival directions at Fukuoka Tower. The arrows on our page met before our stories finished.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 把大濠公园散步便签折成四页，点之间留着远近不同的空隙。翻页时能再点一次自己的节拍。
descriptions.en: My Ohori Park note folded into four pages, its dots spaced like remembered footsteps. A little rhythm for turning pages.
